correctness.rationale: Corrected arXiv v2 Theorem 3.5 supplies sole nonequivariant premise, including integrally torsion-free one-odd-degree homology for every width. For each involution, the augmented signed Lefschetz trace equals the signed sum of invariant matchings over edge orbits. Vertical reversal forbids all nonempty orbits. Central-gap analysis yields chi(h)=F_r and chi(hv)=F_r−2B_r for odd widths; chi(h)=chi(hv)=F_r−2C_r for even widths. Explicit eight-state transition matrix, characteristic polynomial z^4(z+1)(z+2)(z²−2), and eight initial values prove auxiliary formulas for every width by Cayley–Hamilton; substitutions give the four characters and quotient rank. Actual standalone verify.py reconstructed the matrix through width 27 and independently enumerated 47 finite group actions with no discrepancy. Bounded computations corroborate but do not prove infinitely many widths; the displayed recurrence/orbit argument does.

value.rationale: The natural categorical product P_ell×P3 has an established interesting sphere-wedge classification but its two commuting path reversals can act with distinct traces on the same Betti rank. The theorem gives all four rational eigenspace multiplicities uniformly and the quotient Betti number in each congruence class, including vanishing at even width 2 mod 4 and exponential values at odd widths. Those symmetry-sensitive invariants have a motivated topological interpretation and are not implied by the ordinary Betti counts or by Cartesian-grid reflection formulas.
